text:
sam.marketing: hey @mia — heads up: webinar on Apr 14. Need a compact creative mini‑kit for the event: one benchmark infographic that can be adapted to a 1‑pager, 3 social tiles (IG/Twitter/LinkedIn), and an email header. Can you own design + brand gating? target messaging is around predictable inference performance + cost reduction, but keep it high level.

mia.design: ack. can you share the benchmark numbers and copy? also any constraints on visuals (icons, data viz style)? timeline?

raj.product: attaching the quick numbers here — TLDR: optimized runtime vs baseline. Key metrics: "2.1x median throughput", "37% token cost reduction", "p95 latency ~120ms". Copy note: emphasize 'consistent latency & cost' rather than raw model names.

sam.marketing: thanks @raj — copy for the infographic headline: "Predictable inference, lower unit cost". subhead: "Performance tuned for production workloads". CTA variants: "Sign up" and "Request a demo". Deadline: first mock by Thu EOD, final assets by following Mon.

mia.design: cool. quick questions: prefer a single long infographic that we crop for social, or separate artboards per format? also any legal / competitor naming caveats?

olivia.ops: Legal note: avoid mentioning competitor product names or quoting unverified third‑party claims. Use our approved palette and icon set (see /brand/assets). Also include simple alt text for accessibility. :thumbsup:

mia.design: planning to do a modular layout so we can repurpose blocks into social tiles. initial spec (will put in Figma but pasting here):
```
Assets spec:
- infographic hero: 1200x628 (web) and 800x1200 (IG story)
- social tile: 1080x1080 (x3: hero, stat highlight, CTA)
- one‑pager: A4 PDF 300dpi, include TL;DR metrics + 3 callouts
- email header: 600x200
- deliverables: PNG/JPEG for socials, PDF for one‑pager, SVG for charts, Figma file
```

figma-bot: mia.design uploaded file: /files/visuals/1778210000-mini-kit-v1.fig

nate.demand: tagging demand gen — can you keep hero headlines ≤20 chars for paid social? we'll need alt copy for 2 different funnels (inbound vs enterprise).

sam.marketing: yes — two CTA variants and two copy lengths (short for paid, long for webinar landing). also add a note to include a tiny additive line: "Redwood Inference — hosted, dedicated, private" on legal footer.

mia.design: noted. localization? do we need FR/DE?

sam.marketing: start with EN + FR. we'll triage DE after we see final layout.

mia.design: timeline recap: initial mock by Thu EOD, internal review Fri AM, feedback cycle Fri afternoon, final assets ready Mon COB. I'll ping here with Figma link and a short review checklist (colors, alt text, asset naming). If anything blocks me (missing numbers or legal flags) I'll flag immediately. :eyes:

sam.marketing: perfect — thanks! pushing this into the webinar planning doc after review. :rocket:
